about: The broom's bristle end in IN-02-alt (9503416d, the flight ALT; NOT tail-anchored), tracked by eye at 8 fps over 0-1.0 s and 2.25-3.25 s and at 4 fps elsewhere, on 10% grids (480x270 and 384x216 frames), 2026-09-29. Coordinates are 0-1 of the video frame (x by width, y by height); u < -0.02 is 'no emission'. Two emitting stretches: the swoop (0-0.95 s: the broom lifts off the play screen and swings left across the lake, growing toward the camera) and the dive (2.6-3.15 s: out of the close chase, handle first down through the cloud deck into the crest, shrinking). The close chase in between (~1.0-2.5 s) keeps the bristles large at the frame's left edge while the camera tracks them, so it emits nothing (a trail there would pile up in one spot). The broom plunges into the crest at ~3.2 s (the flagged splash-down), so emission stops at emitUntil. s = the broom's apparent size (1 = the close chase).
